doctrine: Trinity IA. Sovereign + 3 scopes (HUMAN · INSTITUTION · EARTH) + cross-cutting /laws. AI agents replace institutions, not humans.

trinity_scopes.doctrine: Substrate, dignity, witness. The people-side of the federation. Sovereignty is preserved — humans are NOT replaced.
Old + new institutions live here. WEALTH is the legacy. arifOS · A-FORGE · AAA are the agentic layer (the new institution). The transformation is visible: old beside new.
Known earth + the void. GEOX computes physical evidence. HERMES sits at the edge where known meets unknown. MCP is the membrane.

sovereign_anchor.doctrine: F13 SOVEREIGN. The human's seat. The bare anchor that holds the federation. Patternless background = the absence of pattern is the marker.

cross_cutting.doctrine: F1-F13 floors. Cross-cutting. The laws that govern. Quieter than scopes — laws are quiet.

organs.doctrine: L0 constitutional kernel. Judges, never executes. F1-F13 floor enforcement. VAULT999 seal chain.
L1 execution shell. Hands. Never self-authorizes. Only acts after SEAL from arifOS.
L1 control plane. A2A gateway. Agent identity registry. The bridge — visually centered between the trinity tiles.
L1 metabolism. FQ pulse. Never judges, never executes. Schedules, routes, checkpoints.
L2 earth. Seismic, wells, basins. Physics-gated geoscience. Falsification engine (K001-K007) before SEAL. The known earth.
L2 capital. NPV, EMV, risk, markets. The OLD institution that lives alongside the new (arifOS, A-FORGE, AAA). Visible in /institution to show the transformation.
L2 readiness. Vitality. Observes, never diagnoses, never prescribes. The substrate organ. D6 canary — Phase 4a applies to WELL first.

D9 declaration. /mcp endpoint posture is REFLECT_ONLY — the bridge is documented but not callable. Discovery surfaces expose the contract; agents reading the surface know the bridge exists but cannot invoke it. Silence is the wrong answer; this is the loudest honest answer.

trinity_visual_bridge.rationale: AAA cockpit sits at the geometric center of the trinity tile row. Three arcs (Trinity Ring toroidal anchor) converge on the AAA bridge. This is the visual contract: human + agent meet at the cockpit.
